assertions: Original map/field enum values, complete mappings and invalid/pixel defaults are preserved.
Five scalar helpers retain native integral/floating rounding and same-direction ControlToItem delegation.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task125 implements original MapUnit/FieldUnit declaration order, aliases/sentinel, complete length maps and pixel override/invalid defaults once in Tools. Original SVTools CalcToUnit,CalcToPoint,ItemToControl,ControlToItem,MapToFieldUnit reuse real common o3tl conversion. Native tools::Long uses BigInt; native float input narrows with Math.fround before double conversion and std::round halfway away fromzero. Integral conversion/negative rounding and overflow preconditions remain owned by o3tl. ControlToItem deliberately preserves same-direction ItemToControl delegation (CALC109), no speculative inverse correction. Static native-only DBG_ASSERT allowed-unit diagnostics are not runtime filtering; original switches accept all valid map length families. Original native SVTools->Tools/o3tl module edges admitted with reverse/application/browser guards retained. Independent literal rational matrices test all mapped units and invalidfallbacks. TransformMetric checked-overflow overload and widget/device helpers remain unported, not stubbed. Shared font-height itself/fullDocPool/config/document/UI/same-modelODS remain pending; this prerequisite is not UI+ODSreadiness. Native caches/refcounts/ABI/native builds/generators/sanitizers/memory libraries excluded. No broad parity promotion; full regression only at actual minimalUI+ODSread/save then fixes/pause.
